name: Reading Pavilion
summary: An open Quran rests inside the large arch of a soft, asymmetric mosque pavilion.
why: The book and the arch share x=59. The rounded minaret is connected to the prayer hall through the left wall, while the book stays within the generous central opening. The page leaves meet at a continuous lower fold, avoiding detached accents.
risk: The large doorway makes the mosque more abstract. At 24px the book reads as a small open fold rather than distinct pages.
sub1: Prayer and reading share the same place
sub2: An upright counterweight to the broad dome
theme: A book held within the arch
reasonToChoose: You want Quran reading expressed inside a simple mosque rather than below it.
